label: Bible Study
prompt: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I _____, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
verse: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
note: Isaiah's call in the temple — he volunteers before he even knows the assignment.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I will not leave you _____: I will come to you.
verse: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
note: The night before the cross Jesus promises not to leave them comfortless — modern versions say 'as orphans.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten _____: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verse: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
note: Aaron made a molten calf while Moses was up the mountain — later claiming it just came out of the fire.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish _____; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
verse: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
note: To Greek philosophers a crucified Savior sounded absurd — Paul agrees it looks foolish, and calls it power anyway.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the _____ are few;
verse: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
note: Plenteous harvest, few 'labourers' — the KJV keeps the British u. Missions Sunday in one sentence.
